pokedexEntries.sw: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

pokedexEntries.sh: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

pokedexEntries.sc: Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live.

pokedexEntries.vi: It senses the feelings of other living creatures. Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions for too long, or it will end up exhausted.
